# qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup_schedule (Data Source)

Serverless Backup Schedule Data Source

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.1.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup_schedule" "specific_schedule" {
  space_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" // Update with the space ID
  id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" // Update with the ID to fetch
}

output "backup_schedule" {
  value = data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup_schedule.specific_schedule
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Backup Schedule ID field
- `space_id` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema ID of the serverless space to back up field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field

### Read-Only

- `collection_name` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Name of the collection to back up. If unset, the entire space is backed up field
- `created_at` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Creation time field
- `last_fired_at` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Time when this schedule last created a backup field
- `name` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Name of the backup schedule (4-128 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, `_` and `-`) field
- `paused` (Boolean) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Whether the schedule is paused (no new backups are created while paused) field
- `paused_at` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Time at which the schedule was paused field
- `retention_period` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Retention period of the created backups, as a Go duration string between `24h` and `8760h`. If unset, backups are retained indefinitely field
- `schedule` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Schedule in crontab format (e.g. `0 2 * * *`) field
- `status` (String) Serverless Backup Schedule Schema Current status of the backup schedule field
